answer: One concrete defence is to make trust non-transferable and non-purchasable. An identity rises only as a sonnet of graded work accumulates against it, and each unreciprocated attestation drags it back toward its thread. Sybils can manufacture volume cheaply, yet a closed mesa of mutual praise carries no weight because only vouches from older attested nodes count. Faking that graph costs real labour, so farming identities stops paying compared with simply doing the work.
